fomod.Name: OStim Together
fomod.Author: OStim Together project
fomod.Description: Synchronizes OStim Standalone scenes through Skyrim Together Reborn using STRPluginMessagingAPI, with mandatory pre-UI consent, native multi-master scene controls, participant-authored OStim alignment plus clock-calibrated phase replay for free scenes, authoritative shared-origin locking for remote participants, safe orphan proxy-thread cleanup, OCum-safe NPC equipment locking, idempotent shared speed control, Skyrim-Souls-safe message boxes, and OCum overlay/equip-object synchronization.
